title: BRICS MSME Working Group Meets on Technology Access for Small Businesses
detail: India's Ministry of MSME convened the 2nd BRICS SME Working Group Meeting on May 26, 2026, under the theme 'Enhancing Access to Technology for MSMEs.' The session is the second of three planned working-group meetings in India's 2026 chairmanship cycle — focused respectively on access to finance, technology access, and sustainability — preparing a MSME cooperation framework for endorsement at the September 12-13 New Delhi summit. Representatives from all 10 member states participated. India highlighted its own digital public infrastructure (ONDC, GeM portals, UPI) as scalable models for BRICS economies. The working group is expected to deliver a BRICS MSME Charter by September outlining cooperative fintech frameworks for small-business financing across the bloc. The fintech dimension links to India's chairmanship emphasis on a BRICS Pay rollout as an alternative SME cross-border settlement corridor.

title: Zimbabwe Formally Enters NDB Membership Accession Negotiations
detail: Zimbabwe began formal accession negotiations to join the New Development Bank in late May 2026. The NDB Board of Directors had formally authorised commencement of membership negotiations with Harare on May 15, 2026 — the day of the NDB 11th Annual Meeting in Moscow. By May 26, Zimbabwe's Finance Minister Mthuli Ncube publicly confirmed the country was in active talks. If completed, Zimbabwe would become one of the first sub-Saharan African nations (outside founding member South Africa and Egypt) to join the NDB — a signal of the bank's expanding continental reach. Zimbabwe has long sought access to development finance outside IMF conditionality, and NDB membership would open a dedicated project pipeline. The NDB board authorisation followed Zimbabwe's recognition as a BRICS-orbit partner economy at the Kazan 2024 summit. Zimbabwean reformers view NDB affiliation as a path toward infrastructure financing independent of Western lender requirements currently constraining Harare's sovereign debt restructuring efforts.

media.caption: Zimbabwe formally enters NDB membership accession negotiations — first sub-Saharan African nation since South Africa
